postures.name: Incident/Offence Committed
postures.description: The alleged crime took place, but no formal FIR or complaint has been registered yet.

postures.name: FIR Registered
postures.description: First Information Report lodged with the Police.

postures.name: Investigation In Progress
postures.description: Police investigation is actively pending under Section 156 CrPC / 175 BNSS.

postures.name: Final Report / Charge Sheet Submitted
postures.description: Police report submitted under Section 173 CrPC / 193 BNSS.

postures.name: Trial in Progress
postures.description: Court has taken cognizance, framed charges, and trial proceedings are pending.

postures.name: Bail / Anticipatory Bail Application
postures.description: Application filed under Section 437/438/439 CrPC or Section 480/482/483 BNSS.

postures.name: Appeal / Revision / Quashing
postures.description: Appeal filed against conviction or revision against interlocutory order or 482 CrPC / 528 BNSS quashing.
